subject: Civil Engineering
title: What Dams Do
description: A quick, practical guide to What Dams Do.

hook.text: A dam blocks a river — storing billions of gallons for drinking, farming, and electricity.

buildup.text: Dams control floods by holding back storm water and releasing it slowly downstream.

discovery.text: Hydropower dams convert falling water into electricity — about 16% of global generation.

twist.text: Dams also create ecosystems — reservoirs become fisheries, wetlands, and recreation areas.

climax.text: Over 58,000 large dams exist worldwide — storing 15% of the world's annual river runoff.

punchline.text: A wall across a river changes everything downstream — water, power, and life.

quiz.question: What percentage of global electricity comes from hydropower dams?
